purpose: Provide one explicit FT-001 integration and documentation sync gate before feature-level completion review.
success_outcome: FT-001 task evidence is coherent, docs are synchronized, and the feature is ready for feature-level red-verification after all tasks close.
anti_goals: No product feature verification without feature-level red-verification.
No new product behavior beyond FT-001 evidence sync.

forbidden_scope: feature-level verified lifecycle without feature red-verification

commands: Check changed code preserves linked Foundation Runtime Substrate, Foundation Data Substrate, Foundation Smoke API when relevant, and Evidence Redaction contracts or records a blocker.

Check FT-001 integration evidence covers argon2-cffi Argon2id parameters, 256-bit session token generation, SHA-256 token_hash-only persistence, constant-time digest comparison, and redaction of auth/session material.
Check FT-001 integration evidence covers agro_intellect_session Set-Cookie attributes, logout clear-cookie behavior, and bearer-mode no-cookie/no-store boundaries when implemented.
Check FT-001 integration evidence covers canonical PlantPermissionContext shape, FT-002 compatibility, denial filtering, AUTH_PLANT_FORBIDDEN no-existence-leak semantics, and auth/context exclusion.
Check every required FT-001 packet source_task_hash matches its task record after docs sync.
Check FT-001 evidence preserves Foundation runtime/data/redaction contracts without claiming FT-002 or FT-003 completion.
success_checks: All FT-001 unit/integration/API tests pass together.

Security primitive contract checks pass for argon2-cffi Argon2id parameters, 256-bit session token entropy, SHA-256 token_hash-only persistence, constant-time digest comparison, and auth/session redaction.

Session API contract checks pass for agro_intellect_session cookie attributes, logout clear-cookie behavior, bearer-mode boundaries when implemented, no-leak auth errors, and Foundation Smoke API preservation.
ActorContext/context-builder checks pass for canonical PlantPermissionContext interface compatibility with FT-002 resolver output, denial filtering, and auth/context exclusion.
Behavior specs are covered by task evidence or linked test output.
FT-001 Memory Bank docs, task record evidence, and changelog are synchronized without claiming FT-002/FT-003 completion.
Feature-level /red-verify --feature FT-001 remains required after all FT-001 tasks are done before treating the feature as complete.
T3 closure includes /verify PASS, /red-verify semantic-pass, HUMAN_CHECKPOINT: done, and ROLLBACK_RECOVERY_NOTE: present.
evidence_required: security primitive contract evidence summary covering TASK-006 and TASK-007
cookie/session API contract evidence summary covering TASK-009
PlantPermissionContext/authz context-builder evidence summary covering TASK-008 and TASK-010

stop_conditions: Any FT-001 prerequisite task is not done.
Security primitive, cookie/session API, or PlantPermissionContext contract evidence is missing from the integrated FT-001 evidence set.
Evidence contains unredacted secrets or auth material.
Docs sync would imply FT-002 or FT-003 completion.
Implementation contradicts verified FT-000 app/settings/database/session/redaction baseline.
